title: auth.org.updated payload
description:
Payload for `auth.org.updated`, published by Auth when an organisation's own record changes (FR-31). Auth is the source of truth for that record and every other service holds a projection, so this is how a projection stays current without polling.

The whole record is carried, not a diff, so a consumer can write the row straight through — `changed` is there for the ones that act on specific fields. `slug` and `status` appear because a projection stores them; neither is editable by an organisation administrator. The slug is stable on purpose (deep links and log lines are full of it), and status is a platform-operator decision, not a tenant's own.

The file name is the routing key — `SchemaDiscovery` keys the catalog by it.

slug.description: Unchanged by this event — carried so a projection can write the row without a second lookup.

status.description: Also unchanged by this event: an organisation cannot suspend or archive itself.

changed.description: Names of the fields this change actually touched.
